title: Ghonchu: a friendly AI tutor for building robots, from a first plastic robot to research (initial drop)
description:
Ghonchu is the friendly tutor of Abhishek Choudhary's robotics course: eighteen Colab notebooks that run on a phone, from a child's first plastic robot, built, connected and tuned in timed parts, to research assistants for clinics, field archaeology, linguistics, psychology and brain-computer interfaces, systems architecture, app generation, volunteer computing grids and an operating-systems course.

Initial drop: the notebooks are extracted from the course's design discussion of 8 November 2026 and have not yet been run end to end; updates follow.
